themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Reviews about push or news-alert notifications: inability to disable them, notifications that persist or won't dismiss after tapping, too-frequent or irrelevant alerts, or requests for or missing alerts.

themes.name: Live stream reliability
themes.description: Reviews about live radio stations and streams connecting, buffering, cutting out, dropping on network switches or phone calls, or failing to play at all.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: Reviews about saving stories to a playlist or queue: playlists disappearing or being erased, items starting mid-story or skipping to the end, playlist organization and access.

themes.name: App crashes and bugs
themes.description: Reviews about the app crashing, force closing, freezing, not launching, or failing to work after an OS or app update, including device-specific glitches like lock-screen flashing.

themes.name: Visual design and interface
themes.description: Reviews about the look, layout, and navigation of the app: outdated UI, Material Design requests, dark theme, font size, ease of finding things, and requests for a redesign.

themes.name: Tablet and landscape support
themes.description: Reviews about the app on tablets or lack of landscape and auto-rotate orientation support.

themes.name: Background service and battery
themes.description: Reviews about the app running constantly in the background, starting on its own, using battery, memory, or data, or being impossible to close.

themes.name: Political bias and trust
themes.description: Reviews about NPR's editorial slant, fairness, fake-news accusations, trustworthiness, accuracy, or journalism quality and reliability as a news source.

themes.name: Ads and sponsorship
themes.description: Reviews about advertisements, pop-up or banner ads, sponsor messages and underwriting in the app, including ads that can't be closed.

themes.name: Chromecast support
themes.description: Reviews requesting or discussing Chromecast or Google Cast casting, including comparisons to NPR One having it.

themes.name: Offline downloads
themes.description: Reviews requesting or discussing downloading podcasts, stories, or articles for offline listening or reading.

themes.name: Local station finding
themes.description: Reviews about searching for, selecting, saving, or locating local NPR stations, including missing stations and favorites that disappear.

themes.name: Widget
themes.description: Reviews about the home-screen or lock-screen widget and its functionality, size, or bugs.

themes.name: Comparison to NPR One
themes.description: Reviews comparing this app to the NPR One app, including preferences, feature differences, and complaints that NPR One gets the focus.

themes.name: Permissions and privacy
themes.description: Reviews about the permissions the app requests, access to phone or call info and location, and data collection concerns.

themes.name: Article content display
themes.description: Reviews about how article text, images, tweets, videos, and captions are displayed in the app, including overlapping text and missing media.

themes.name: Program availability and updates
themes.description: Reviews about whether specific programs, episodes, and hourly news appear and refresh on time, including stale content, missing shows, and the programs tab failing.

themes.name: Playback skipping
themes.description: Reviews about audio skipping forward or backward, repeating segments, cutting off before the end, or playing from the wrong position during playback.
